proof_attempt_summary: Discovery derived matched constant-factor minimax squared-risk and honest-length rates for the full nonlinear global-Lipschitz Bernoulli model, with stopped change of measure, capped hybrid procedures, legal lower alternatives, and a standalone Gaussian obstruction. All twelve citations and the mathematical/rubric panels cleared after dependency and related-work repairs, but the field-tier claim failed the 7.2 paper-score ceiling against the 7.4 threshold. Formalization never ran: no Lean verification or formal proof artifact is claimed; sharp constants and broader observational/policy models remain open.
tldr: On the full nonlinear global Lipschitz Bernoulli class with known Gaussian covariance, the covariance-attenuation causal contrast has minimax squared risk \(n^{-2\kappa/(1+\kappa)}\) and finite-sample 90\%-honest connected-interval length \(n^{-\kappa/(1+\kappa)}\), up to positive constants depending only on the public parameters, where \(t^2\kappa(\kappa+1)+a\kappa=a\). Both directions hold without logarithmic corrections, and finite-coordinate procedures with certified arithmetic allowances attain these orders. The standalone diagnostic theorem \texttt{thm:gaussian-prefix-obstruction} proves finite-prefix normalization, \(k^{2t^2}\) second-moment growth, almost-sure logarithmic likelihood convergence to \(-t^2\) under \(P\) and \(t^2\) under \(Q\), mutual singularity, and failure of the regular ratio premise. The causal contrast is identified by the declared universal continuous structural mean. Sharp first-order minimax constants and their attainment remain the separate open question. Spectral attenuation is an idealized benchmark for Jiang--Cui--Huling's nighttime-intensity policy question; their literal intervention acts on a time window.
gap: Regular functional-policy results control finite-score likelihood moments, while generic off-policy recovery does not evaluate this singular Gaussian Lipschitz scalar contrast.
fill: The theorem obligations evaluate the critical rate through an exact stopped moment and a legal multiscale lower alternative, and attach total finite-coordinate attainment and finite-sample honest length.
